title: Pipe geometry.
officialText:
Any shaped single-wall metal pipe shall be permitted to be used, provided that its equivalent effective
area is equal to the effective area of the round pipe for which it is substituted, and provided that the minimum internal dimension of
the pipe is not less than 2 inches (51 mm).
